verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents API tokens that can be created and expired in the dashboard, which covers the API-key part of the story. The permissions doc only recommends storing user_id/group_ids on documents and filtering at query time. That is an application-side pattern, not access control enforced by the database, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: role-based access control, per-namespace (per-collection) scoped keys or permissions, granular read/write operation scoping, independent corroboration.
